analysis.purpose: cmdExport.ExportFormat is a local type alias inside cmdExport that narrows the allowed export formats to the literal union defined by the formats array: rules, mermaid, graph.json, or report.
responsibilities: Constrain the export format parameter to the supported set of formats
risks: Spec-only type alias; runtime enforcement depends on the cast and includes check in cmdExport
whatToDistrust: coverage.readiness is 'unimplemented'; the type alias itself has no runtime behavior

nodes.name: Export format
nodes.summary: Supported output formats for crib export: rules, mermaid, graph.json, report

edges.rationale: The type alias defines the set of supported export formats
